units.text: INT. LIGHTHOUSE GALLEY - POTLUCK NIGHT
A cramped round kitchen at the base of a lighthouse.
Casserole dishes crowd every surface.
A foghorn blares every ten seconds.
ROSALIND (60s, apron, vengeful smile) guards a bundt cake.
EDMUND (60s, golf shirt) carves a ham.
CHIKA (30s, nose ring, crisp linen) pours wine.
DMITRI (40s, ponytail, guitar case) leans on the counter.
BEA (20s, headphones around neck) scrolls her phone.
I'm only saying that some of us brought homemade.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Rosalind, it's the same casserole you brought to the last four potlucks.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: It's a family recipe.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: It's from a can.
units.name: CHIKA

units.text: Cream of mushroom. I smelled it in the parking lot.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Aunt Rosalind, are you aware you're yelling?
units.name: BEA

units.text: I am explaining.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Over the foghorn.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: Because I'm tired of being the villain in this lighthouse!
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Nobody said villain.
units.name: CHIKA

units.text: I said cannibal. The cake looks human.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: It's a bundt!
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Honey, put the knife down.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: This is a cake server!
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: It's honestly a very sharp cake server.
units.name: BEA

units.text: The door bangs open.
AUNT FENELLA (80s, fur stole, cane held like a spear) sweeps in, trailing mist.
Everyone stops.
I'm told someone has been slandering my casserole.
units.name: AUNT FENELLA

units.text: Your casserole?
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Cream of mushroom, 1974. I invented it at this very counter.
units.name: AUNT FENELLA

units.text: Nobody told us that.
units.name: EDMUND

units.text: Why would anyone tell us that?
units.name: CHIKA

units.text: Because they're afraid of her.
units.name: DMITRI

units.text: Quite right.
units.name: AUNT FENELLA

units.text: I'm getting cake.
units.name: BEA

units.text: Nobody touch the cake.
units.name: ROSALIND
